title: Document merge-task JSON envelope schema
description:
scripts/merge-task.mjs now emits a JSON envelope with 5+ structured keys: mergeSha, shardClose, linkedShardClose, commit, plus exitCode/source. Architect-reviewer flagged ARCH-N-016-8: consumers (orchestrator skill) currently parse this envelope by convention only — there is no schema definition.

Document the contract before sprint-4 adds a 6th key. Two acceptable approaches:
(a) Add a TypeScript .d.ts in lib/ describing the envelope shape (no transpile needed; .d.ts is documentation-only for ESM JS).
(b) Add a structured section to lib/README.md with field name, type, when-emitted, when-omitted, and example payloads.

Prefer (b) unless the user wants editor IntelliSense (in which case do both — .d.ts emits hover hints in VS Code).
acceptance_criteria: lib/README.md (or lib/merge-task-envelope.d.ts) documents the envelope shape including all of: mergeSha, shardClose, linkedShardClose, commit, exitCode, source
Each field is documented with: type, semantic meaning, when emitted vs omitted, and at least one example payload
Documentation is referenced from a comment block at the top of scripts/merge-task.mjs near the JSON.stringify emit point
No code change required; pure docs
